title: tumor vs lung_adjacent_normal from 'source name', 8 samples, 37,536 nuclei after QC, 32 clusters
summary: 4 tumor and 4 lung_adjacent_normal samples from the authors' processed matrices in GEO: 37,575 nuclei before QC, 37,536 after removing nuclei with fewer than 200 genes or more than 10% mitochondrial counts (the single-nucleus cut-off), and genes seen in fewer than 3 nuclei.
32 Leiden clusters at resolution 0.5: the largest has 3,914 nuclei, the smallest 61.

Pseudobulk DESeq2 (tumor vs lung_adjacent_normal) ran in 8 of 32 clusters that had at least 2 samples per condition with 10 or more nuclei: 309 gene tests at padj < 0.05 in total, most in cluster 15 (155 of 10,266 tested).

14 of the 32 clusters are more than 90% one sample (5 from GSM7157645, 3 from GSM7157649, 2 from GSM7157648, 1 from GSM7157647, 1 from GSM7157646, 1 from GSM7157644, 1 from GSM7157650): donor or batch structure rather than shared cell types, since no integration is run here; the pseudobulk test skips them.
25 of 33 samples were left out: 25 beyond the cap of 4 samples per condition.

figures.title: UMAP
figures.caption: Left: UMAP of 37,536 nuclei in 32 Leiden clusters, numbered on the plot; right: the same nuclei coloured by condition (tumor orange, lung_adjacent_normal blue).

figures.title: Marker genes
figures.caption: The top 3 Wilcoxon marker genes of each of the 32 clusters (86 genes): dot size is the fraction of nuclei in the cluster expressing the gene, colour its mean expression scaled from 0 to 1 per gene.

warnings: Samples are nested in people: cells from the same donor are not independent; pseudobulk per sample avoids that, but n is the number of samples, not cells.
Clusters are Leiden communities, not annotated cell types; read the marker genes before naming them.
The matrices are the authors' processed output (their cell calling, reference and filtering); locus did not recount the reads.
14 clusters are more than 90% one sample; no batch integration (Harmony, scVI) is run here, so cluster membership partly reflects the donor.
